narration: Is your team's to-do list scattered across inboxes, spreadsheets and sticky notes? Task management is now live in InvestorJoint.
Work the way you like, on a board or a list. Drag cards between lanes you name yourself.
Every card holds everything: several assignees, checklists, labels, files, dates, and your own custom fields.
Link a task to a property, an entity or a contact, or turn an email straight into a task.
Workflows run themselves. Set out the steps by role, repeat them monthly or quarterly, or start them automatically when a lease is signed.
And nothing slips through, with bell and email alerts when you're assigned, and reminders when work is due or overdue.
Less chasing, more done. Find it under Tasks in the sidebar. And your first property is free, at InvestorJoint dot com dot A U.
